name: GitHub PR Review
purpose: Perform thorough automated and manual code review on pull requests.
inputs: Pull request URL, base branch, description, and linked issue
Complete diff, changed paths, tests, and CI checks
Architecture, security, compatibility, and performance criteria
outputs: Evidence-based review verdict and severity-ranked findings
Actionable inline comments with file, line, and rationale
Architecture, security, compatibility, test, and CI gate record
stop_conditions: The verdict is evidence-based, blocking concerns are actionable, and all required gates are recorded
